description: Closed-aircraft source of truth after the latest model run. Use this file for UAV specs; resolved_configuration.json also contains template/calibration seeds that are not closed-run values.

model.name: H2AIR Integrated Model
model.description: Single-entry H2AIR model with separated user inputs, automatic lifting-surface sizing, measured linear-mass manufacturing model, polar-based airfoils, CAD export, discrete hardware selection and IE-SOAR cross-fuselage cooling integration.

run.fidelity_note: Integrated-v4 closure/optimization is screening fidelity. Airfoil polars are used directly where supplied; missing airfoils retain explicit screening fallbacks. Selected motor/prop/battery data remain subject to supplier/bench validation and pusher forward-flight correlation.

main_wing.note: Temporarily set equal to the current H2AIR CLmax=1.185 to preserve model continuity. Replace with Reynolds-specific XFOIL/CFD/test polar before design freeze.

horizontal_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.

vertical_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.

main_wing_shell.source: Target ~2.2 kg printed wing shell at current span (2.2/3.516557 m)

horizontal_tail_shell.source: Target ~0.5 kg printed HT shell at current span (0.5/0.828897 m)

vertical_tail_shell.source: Target ~0.25 kg printed twin-fin shells at current height (0.25/(2*0.327641 m))

carbon_fiber_tubes.note: Even-mm COTS lock from lightest PASS after printed-shell update (wing 23.25/17.44→24/18, boom 21.25/17.25→22/18, HT 9.0→10/8, VT 7.5→8/6; landing legs auto 8/6).

detail.warning: Supplier fan airflow/static-pressure data are not available in the supplied IE-SOAR documents; airflow PASS/FAIL therefore uses explicit engineering-assumption fan capacity and must be replaced by supplier or bench data.

gates.name: fuel_cell_cooling_geometry

gates.note: IE-SOAR fan/system airflow and allowable external pressure-drop data are not present in the supplied documentation; current airflow capacity is an engineering assumption to be replaced by supplier or bench data.

gates.note: Wing area 0.917 m² vs minimum 0.903 m² screen.

gates.name: mission_ems
gates.note: Dynamic mission profile through hybrid H2/battery EMS.

gates.name: transition
gates.note: Forward and reverse point-mass transition completion on closed mass.

gates.name: sixdof_linear_aero_validity
gates.note: 6-DOF coefficient model uses linear aerodynamic derivatives outside the CL clamp; high-alpha results require nonlinear AVL/CFD/wind-tunnel/flight correlation. Maximum |alpha| above 10 m/s = 8.1 deg.

gates.name: 15kg_zero_pitch_motor_thrust
gates.note: Front/rear requirement 66.0/56.7 N vs 71.0 N available screen.

gates.name: recommended_structure_screen
gates.note: Recommended structural member screens. Audit reference/current/legacy sections and the legacy partial-feedback mass gate are excluded because integrated-v2 already closes structural mass explicitly and checks the actual closed MTOW separately.

gates.name: motor_mount
gates.note: Controlled mount CAD, fasteners and material allowables are still required.

gates.name: selected_battery_database_record
gates.note: Selected battery mass/envelope are present in the controlled hardware database; final release still requires supplier/measured validation.

notes: AUTO selection is a database screening step. Final propulsion release requires measured thrust/power/thermal data at the selected voltage and propeller.
Battery current screen conservatively assumes simultaneous maximum lift + pusher database power.
Aircraft bus ceiling is 48.0 V (fuel-cell max); hardware bus_max is capped accordingly (not 12S×4.2=50.4 V).
